<title level="1" right="Action">[Rearrange Bones](/Actions.aspx?ID=2261) <actions string="Single Action" /></title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Wake the Dead #4](/Sources.aspx?ID=219) pg. 28

</column>

---

([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) You arrange your bones into the form of a Small or medium humanoid's skeleton. This doesn't change your normal Speeds, Strikes, or senses. If you are wearing heavy clothing or impersonating a skeleton, this counts as setting up a disguise for the Impersonate use of Deception, and grants a +1 status bonus to those Deception checks.
name: Rearrange Bones
